entities.summary: Arthur Murray was an American ballroom dancer and businessman, whose name is most often associated with the dance studio chain that bears his name. Arthur Murray was a performers & entertainers from Pidhaitsi (1895-04-04, Pidhaitsi–1991-03-03). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
